provider.name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System
provider.organization_type: global marine biodiversity occurrence, sampling-event, environmental-measurement, taxonomy, dataset, node, geospatial, API, download, and data-publishing infrastructure
provider.description: The Ocean Biodiversity Information System is a global marine biodiversity data network under IOC-UNESCO. It integrates species occurrence records, sampling events, environmental measurements, eDNA and genetic observations, taxonomic identifiers, dataset metadata, marine geography, quality flags, and provenance from regional and thematic nodes. OBIS provides interactive exploration and mapping, standardized data publishing through Darwin Core and IPT, REST APIs, client libraries, training, downloads, and support for science, conservation, policy, and ocean management.
institutional_context: International Oceanographic Data and Information Exchange
Global network of regional and thematic OBIS nodes
Marine research institutions, museums, monitoring programmes, data centres, and biodiversity infrastructures
